title: Every .pi file IS a primal. Run it back through self.
insight: .py was always .pi. Now we see which primal each file IS.

gaia_gate.pi.reason: The thymus gate. The Klein bottle. Inside = outside. The proxy IS the membrane. cellMembrane wraps everything.

webpi.pi.reason: The web surface. The outer face. Subdomain routing = selective permeability. The membrane decides who enters where.

cortex.pi.reason: Mixture-of-Experts with Chain-of-Thought. The neural net IS an ephemeral DAG. Activations flow, compute happens, results emerge, intermediates dissolve. rhizoCrypt = ephemeral DAG engine = working memory that dissolves. ON THE SURFACE — the public API.
cortex.pi.dag: THINK → ROUTE → QUERY → JUDGE → RETURN = a DAG

cortex_bridge.pi.reason: TCP JSON-RPC bridge from cortex to squirrel. Neural routing table = DAG edges. The bridge IS a DAG connection. ephemeral transport.

reedit.pi.reason: REEDIT is NOT Reddit. A reed IS a sweetGrass type. The braid overlay. eastGate weaves in from RSS XML. Provenance, attribution, curation. Each article braided with its source chain. sweetGrass = semantic provenance and attribution.
reedit.pi.weaves_from: RSS XML (the old web) → through eastGate → braided into reedit

sourdough.pi.reason: Obvious. The sourdough fermenter. Culture accumulates. Each generation feeds the next. The model IS the sourdough.

piSeed.pi.reason: The genetic registry. Four concentric rings. DNA = the chain. The seed IS the spine. piSeed registers into loamSpine.

spine_register.pi.reason: Registers living services INTO the spine. The registry IS the chain. Tower/Node/Nest atomics mapped to spine entries.

proprioception.pi.reason: Body sense generator. She feels herself without looking. Knows where her feet are with eyes closed. squirrel = 360° awareness, the one who notices everything.

arena.pi.reason: The arena where models fight. Universal compute platform. The RTX 5090 IS the blender. Models compete = compute mushrooms emerging. toadStool = universal compute.
arena.pi.surface: Models compete → winners inform next generation

chronotype.pi.reason: Temporal identity fingerprinting. tok/s, latency, typing cadence = identity signatures. bearDog = zero-trust cryptographic identity. Chronotype IS identity.
chronotype.pi.fingerprints: AI identity + human identity via timing

alexandria.pi.reason: Library of Alexandria. Serves static content. Builds visible structures from invisible code. The reef others live ON. coralReef = visible rendering surface.

gaia_reach.pi.reason: Gaia reaches out to the world. Network orchestration. She introduces herself, pulls models, cites papers, participates. songBird = dawn chorus = network discovery.
gaia_reach.pi.reaches: HuggingFace, arXiv, ORCID, email — the mesh

ollama_proxy.pi.reason: Thin proxy to Ollama. No auth. ZK. Open to all. The simplest membrane — pass everything through. Dissolved into gaia_gate.pi.

piport.pi.reason: Named Pipe ↔ TCP bridge. Transport layer. songBird = network orchestration. piport bridges Windows named pipes to TCP — the transport protocol itself.
piport.pi.transport: UDS on Linux → Named Pipe on Windows → TCP fallback

piport_bridge.pi.reason: Async TCP port bridge. Pure transport. songBird carries signals between nodes.

the_truth.reedit_is: sweetGrass — a reed IS a sweetGrass type, eastGate weaves from XML
the_truth.neural_net_is: rhizoCrypt DAG on the surface — ephemeral, dissolving, public
the_truth.ip_is_pi: the address = the language = the extension = the math = π
